# Azoth & Co.

> Azoth & Co. is an AI and operations consulting firm based in Dallas–Fort Worth, Texas, working with clients nationwide. Tagline: "Operations, rebuilt." It turns manual work (retyping, chasing, rebuilding reports) into systems staff actually use. Founder: Denzel Yeboah. Legal name: Azoth & Co. Consulting LLC.

Every engagement starts with a diagnosis, not a proposal:

- **Map**: fixed-fee process mapping that ends in a written Blueprint the client keeps.
- **Build**: workflow automation and AI agents, reporting and a single source of truth, document intelligence, internal tools and portals, and AI enablement.
- **Retainer**: ongoing monitoring and improvement of what was built.
- **Visibility Audit**: for owner-led local businesses, a review of how the business shows up in Google, maps and AI answers.

Clients: investment and professional firms, growing companies, and owner-led businesses. NDA before discovery; confidential data is never put into consumer AI tools.

- [About](https://azothandco.com/about/): who we are and how we work
